purpose: Separate simulated active-enrollment arm; no additional confirmations have been evaluated at protocol freeze
candidate_uncertainty: Maximum enrolled-identity cosine below0.65 OR distinct-identity margin below0.10
candidate_priority: Lowest maximum enrolled-identity similarity, then lowest distinct-identity margin, then original row order
human_response: Publisher truth is revealed only after a candidate is selected. Count every request, including unknown cows and already-at-cap known cows. Unknowns remain unenrolled.
replacement_rule: Retain all newly confirmed references and remove the original reference having highest cosine similarity to another same-cow reference. Gallery stays <=10/cow.
threshold_selection: Calibrate only after enrollment on1230–1529, target99%namedprecision/1%unknownFA; no use of development labels for candidate priority
scope: Oracle boxes and perfect human responses; no deployed tracking or automatic pseudo-label claim. Existing330–629 development data is explicitly repurposed for enrollment in this separate arm.
